artifacts.summary: Rules on the trigger surface, matching rule, and output contract for a cross-task refutation sweep, and resolves the positive-direction amendment by reusing the dormant memory-harvest.sh pipeline instead of spawning a new task.

next_steps: Run /plan 319 to create an implementation plan for scripts/sweep-invalidated-claims.sh and its regression test; a later wiring task adds both this sweep and an immediate memory-harvest.sh call to orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh.

memory_candidates.content: Before designing new cross-task propagation or harvest infrastructure, grep for an existing script's own 'presently uncalled' / 'no caller in the pipeline' header disclaimer. scripts/memory-harvest.sh in this codebase already implemented memory_candidates -> vault harvesting (confidence-gated, deduped) but had zero callers because skill-todo's HarvestMemories stage duplicated the logic inline and scoped it to /todo's completed-task archival batch only. The fix was a new call site at the right trigger point, not new infrastructure.

decisions_made (.orchestrator-handoff.json) and .decisions.json are both unreachable/ill-shaped for recording a research-dispatch finding: decisions_made is never written by research agents in any mode (only plan/implement), and .decisions.json is scoped exclusively to user_decision AskUserQuestion answers (question/answer/cycle/timestamp), written only by the orchestrator loop's own branch move after the user answers -- never by a dispatched agent. A new producer-owned top-level field on .return-meta.json (the proposed_file_scope / user_decision precedent) is the correct extension point for a new research-agent-only structured signal.
